title: Boolean function over the two-element field
statement: For a function $f$ from the $n$-dimensional sign cube $\\{-1,1\\}^n$ to $\\{\\pm1\\}$, define its two-element-field encoding on $\\mathbb F_2^n$ by identifying each input sign vector with its binary vector and each output sign with its corresponding element of $\\mathbb F_2$.
hypotheses_covered: An input function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube with values in $\\{\\pm1\\}$
